mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Server - Tool Listener - Expired Plans
mcp:tool-listener.name: get-customer-with-expired-or-expiring-plans
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description:
Retrieve customer accounts whose plan has already expired or whose plan will expire within the specified number of days from the current date.
The "days" parameter defines the expiry window. For example, if days is 30, the tool returns customers whose Valid Till date is on or before 30 days from today.
Customers are ordered by Valid Till date in ascending order, so customers with the earliest expiry dates appear first.
The response always contains the available customer records in a table format with the following columns: Customer ID, Customer Name, Account Number, Email, Joined Date, Tenure (Years), Last Billing Date, Valid Till, Total Revenue, Autopay Enabled, Contact Preference, Churn Score, and Churn Risk Level.
If no customers have expired or expiring plans within the specified period, the tool returns an empty result.

logger.doc:name: Log - Request Received
logger.message: #["[expired-plan-customer-flow] Tool invoked - days: " ++ (payload.days as String default "null")]

salesforce:query.salesforce:salesforce-query: SELECT Id, Name, AccountNumber, Email__c, Joined_on__c, tenure_year__c, Last_Billing_Date__c, Valid_Till__c, Total_Revenue__c, Autopay_Enabled__c, Contact_Preferances__c, Churn_Score__c, Churn_Risk_Level__c FROM Account WHERE Valid_Till__c <= :endDate ORDER BY Valid_Till__c ASC

logger.doc:name: Log - Query Result
logger.message: #["[expired-plan-customer-flow] Salesforce query returned " ++ (sizeOf(payload) as String) ++ " records"]
